0.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_1
0.description: I am Ser Alberic Bale, knight of Ishgard in service to the Holy See.

5.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_2
5.description: I am a knight of the Holy See, sworn for life─as we all are. In addition to my duties in service to the See, my fellow knights and I are tasked with protecting Ishgard from the dragons─the wyrms who have beset our nation throughout its history.

6.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_3
6.description: In the past this duty fell not to the knights of the See, but to a specialized brigade known as the dragoons. In my younger days, I was one of them─verily, their leader, bearing the title of Azure Dragoon.

7.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_4
7.description: Many years ago, I retired from active duty to serve the See. My former post is now held by my erstwhile student, an accomplished young dragoon by the name of Estinien.

8.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_5
8.description: The dragoons are an elite contingent of Ishgardian knights who serve to protect our nation from the wrath of the fearsome wyrms that would raze us to the ground.

9.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_6
9.description: The first─and greatest─of the dragoons was none other than Haldrath the Dragonseye, hero of the Founding Wars. It was he who drove back the great wyrm Nidhogg, claiming the powers of the Eye for Ishgard.

10.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_7
10.description: Dragoons must display complete mastery of their chosen weapon, the lance, that they might stand against their immense foe. The leader of the dragoons is known as the Azure Dragoon, and is chosen by the Eye, a relic guarded within the Holy See which bestows upon the chosen one the power of the dragon.

11.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_8
11.description: And yet this power is as a double-edged sword, for if the dragoon does not maintain absolute control over his emotions, he shall fall under the thrall of the very wyrms that he would slay. But so it always has been─no great power comes without a cost.

13.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_200
13.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I trust you have been dedicating yourself to honing your skills as a dragoon.

14.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_230
14.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I trust you have been dedicating yourself to honing your skills as a dragoon.

16.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_340
16.description: Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I yet struggle to fully grasp the scale of the search we are dealing with. It shall doubtless prove a formidable challenge indeed.

17.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_341
17.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Our young dragon friend has informed me of your trials and tribulations in the Far East. I was most glad to hear word of Estinien, however, I cannot help but wonder just how he found himself so far from Ishgard.

18.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_350
18.description: I heard about what happened at the Ghimlyt Dark. 'Twould seem that Estinien chose to wait in the wings rather than to take center stage, though he played a decisive role in the drama that unfolded.

24.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_100
24.description: With Estinien having left us, the post of the Azure Dragoon has been vacated for the first time in the See's recorded history.

25.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_101
25.description: If I said that the current state of affairs did not put me ill at ease, I would be a liar.

26.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_102
26.description: And yet, I am but a lone dragoon, and it is not my place to question. And so I place my trust in my superiors, and defend the See with my life.

27.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_210
27.description: Right glad was I to learn that Estinien has regained mastery over the dragon within.

28.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_212
28.description: Unfortunately, he cannot rejoin his fellow dragoons. He has duties of his own to fulfill, and will continue acting independently for the foreseeable future.

29.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_213
29.description: In his absence, it is to your strength that we must turn in times of need. I pray that you will continue standing with us, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

30.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_260
30.description: Yet again, the Holy See is bereft of its greatest champion... With all my heart, I pray that Estinien returns to us.

31.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_261
31.description: In his absence, it is to your strength that we must turn in times of need. I pray that you will continue standing with us, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

32.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_220
32.description: Right glad was I to learn that Estinien has regained mastery over the dragon within.

33.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_221
33.description: Unfortunately, he cannot rejoin his fellow dragoons. He has duties of his own to fulfill, and will continue acting independently for the foreseeable future.

35.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_223
35.description: In his absence, Heustienne has stepped up to lead the Order of the Knights Dragoon.

36.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_201
36.description: Yet again, the Holy See is bereft of its greatest champion... With all my heart, I pray that Estinien returns to us.

37.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_202
37.description: But until such time as he does, we must carry on as best we can.

38.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_203
38.description: The most immediate concern is the mission to slay Graoully, which Heustienne is charged with leading. Pray lend her your strength, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

39.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_250
39.description: Right glad was I to learn that Estinien has regained mastery over the dragon within.

40.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_251
40.description: Unfortunately, he cannot rejoin his fellow dragoons. He has duties of his own to fulfill, and will continue acting independently for the foreseeable future.

41.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_252
41.description: As such, we cannot expect him to take up Heustienne's mantle. You are our sole hope in this dark hour, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

42.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_240
42.description: I'll not mince words: the situation is grim. Graoully's reign of terror continues, and Heustienne remains unaccounted for.

43.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_241
43.description: Deprived of their finest warriors, the dragoons struggle to bear the burden. You are our sole hope in this dark hour, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

44.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_300
44.description: With Estinien having left us, the post of the Azure Dragoon has been vacated for the first time in the See's recorded history. And now Heustienne, too, is gone...

45.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_301
45.description: Deprived of their finest warriors, those dragoons that remain struggle to bear the burden.

46.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_302
46.description: For though Graoully shall plague us no more, he is but one drop in the ocean.

47.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_303
47.description: Slowly but surely, we must rebuild our forces. For my part, I shall continue training the next generation of our nation's defenders.

48.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_304
48.description: I pray that you will continue to stand with us, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.

49.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_280
49.description: The recent revelations have shaken Ishgard to its very foundation. Amidst this turmoil, the dragons continue their bloody rampage.

50.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_281
50.description: Deprived of their finest warriors, the dragoons struggle to bear the burden. But bear it they must.

51.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_282
51.description: For my part, I shall continue training the next generation of our nation's defenders.

52.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_283
52.description: And if there is a way to free Estinien from Nidhogg's clutches, I mean to find it.

53.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_310
53.description: The recent revelations have shaken Ishgard to its very foundation. Amidst this turmoil, the dragons continue their bloody rampage.

54.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_311
54.description: Deprived of their finest warriors, the dragoons struggle to bear the burden. But bear it they must.

55.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_312
55.description: For my part, I shall continue training the next generation of our nation's defenders.

56.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_313
56.description: Even with Nidhogg slain, the hatred his scattered Horde bears towards us is undying. An attack may not come this day or the next, but it <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> come, and we must be unceasing in our vigilance.

57.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_320
57.description: Your slaying of Nidhogg's shade marked the end of the Dragonsong War.

58.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_321
58.description: There are of course members of the Horde that still harbor a fierce hatred in their hearts for the Holy See; some may even launch an assault upon us. However, their flame does not burn as bright as it once did.

59.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_322
59.description: We too have admittedly lost both Estinien and Heustienne, but the dragoons that remain grow in strength each day that passes. Ishgard need fear naught while we still draw breath.

60.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_323
60.description: We must also keep one eye on future generations. It is our duty to pass on both the traditions and techniques that have been born as a result of this thousand-year conflict; not to mention the truth behind it that you brought to light.

61.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_351
61.description: I and the other members of the Temple Knights are striving to heal the scars of the Dragonsong War. There is much yet to be done in rebuilding Ishgard, though considerable progress has been made.

62.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_352
62.description: Some things, however, never change, such as Estinien's reluctance to send so much as a simple letter to his former teacher. From what I hear, he has developed a penchant for making timely interventions before swiftly disappearing again.

63.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_353
63.description: I also have not seen much of Heustienne, though according to Orn Khai, she continues to hone her skills by hunting in Dravania.

64.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_400
64.description: How fare <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103>? All the better for seeing you hale and whole, my friend. Though I and the rest of the Ilsabard contingent had every confidence you would return safely, 'twas far from a foregone conclusion.

65.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_401
65.description: A sentiment shared, 'twould seem, by Estinien. After returning from your journey beyond the stars, he paid me a visit. He spoke as if those words might be his last.

66.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_402
66.description: Indeed, he was more candid than I have ever known him. His tribulations with Nidhogg have left him a changed man in many ways...and not all for the worse. Since meeting you and yours, he has learned to put his past behind him... A past that I know only too well.

67.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_403
67.description: And now, you and Estinien have saved the world that Midgardsormr himself chose as the last hope for his kind. Man and dragon alike owe much and more to your great deeds.

68.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_110
68.description: The dragoons are an elite contingent of Ishgardian knights who serve to protect our nation from the wrath of the fearsome wyrms that would raze us to the ground. As you should know well, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, having been initiated in our ways.

69.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_111
69.description: The first─and greatest─of the dragoons was none other than Haldrath the Dragonseye, hero of the Founding Wars. It was he who drove back the great wyrm Nidhogg, claiming the powers of the Eye for Ishgard.

70.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_112
70.description: Dragoons must display complete mastery of their chosen weapon, the lance, that they might stand against their immense foe. The leader of the dragoons is known as the Azure Dragoon, and is chosen by the Eye, a relic guarded within the Holy See which bestows upon the chosen one the power of the dragon.

71.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_113
71.description: And yet this power is as a double-edged sword, for if the dragoon does not maintain absolute control over his emotions, he shall fall under the thrall of the very wyrms that he would slay. But so it always has been─no great power comes without a cost.

76.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_330
76.description: The days when a dragoon's sole purpose was to slay Dravanians are gone.

77.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_331
77.description: They ended as soon as you helped bring a conclusion to the Dragonsong War by dispatching Nidhogg's shade.

78.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_332
78.description: Estinien's decision to abandon both the Eyes and the mantle of Azure Dragoon truly epitomize this sudden change.

79.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_333
79.description: One would imagine we dragoons will need to follow Ser Aymeric's lead by adapting to these new times. Many hailed him an Azure Dragoon for a new age in the wake of the thousand-year war.

80.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_355
80.description: The days when a dragoon's sole purpose was to slay Dravanians are gone. They ended as soon as you helped bring a conclusion to the Dragonsong War by dispatching Nidhogg's shade.

81.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_356
81.description: Now that the Eye from which we drew our power has been destroyed, the long line of Azure Dragoons has been broken.

82.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_357
82.description: With Nidhogg, the self-appointed defender of this star, gone, it falls to brave souls such as you and Estinien to protect it in his stead.

83.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_450
83.description: I am grateful for the opportunity to play a part in the contingent's vital work. The others were kind enough to grant me leave, that I may assess the situation here in Coerthas. Though I plan to remain a while longer, I shall return to Ilsabard once my business here is concluded.

84.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_460
84.description: I and the other members of the diversionary force were sorely tested, but I am pleased to say each and every one of us made it back to camp. Aye, some might call it a miracle, though in truth, it was the result of careful planning and the various delegates working as a unified whole.

85.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_461
85.description: I must say, I had my doubts about Lord Emmanellain's ability to hold his own under such conditions. In the end, the lad acquitted himself rather well. I think we have his ongoing rivalry with Sicard to thank for his newfound resolve.

86.name: TEXT_JOBDEFDRG_00092_ALBERIC_000_462
86.description: Theirs was but one example of promising young warriors combining their unique strengths for a single purpose.
